summary:
Arya Arian. Houston, TX.
Education: MBA, Rice University (2026). BS Biochemistry, minor in Business, University of Texas at Austin (2020).
Experience:
- Research Investigator, CPRIT Texas EVCore, UT MD Anderson Cancer Center (June 2026 to present): leads development of the core's operational infrastructure; has managed 20 custom projects for academic and industry clients; works with investigators and clients to refine project requirements and design fit-for-purpose study plans; runs assays under SOP-controlled, documented workflows; manages custom projects from sample intake through final reporting, including troubleshooting, data interpretation, quality review and communicating results.
- MSAT Scientist and Lab Manager, PranaX (April 2024 to May 2026): first employee; led end-to-end build-out and operation of an ISO 7 cleanroom for GMP-compliant exosome manufacturing, from empty space to operational in 6 months on a $1M budget; supported clinical manufacturing of 30 GMP lots; negotiated directly with all equipment vendors and purchasing organizations; authored 200+ SOPs and batch records; primary trainer for all 5 staff; directed technology transfer, process development, scale-up and MSAT activities supporting clinical manufacturing; was in charge of equipment procurement and IQ/OQ/PQ (oversaw qualification; did not personally execute it), aseptic operations, SOPs, batch-record development, QC and regulatory alignment.
- Research Scientist, Kalluri Laboratory, Dept. of Cancer Biology, UT MD Anderson (March 2021 to March 2024): translational extracellular vesicle research in cancer immunology, vaccine development and regenerative medicine; EVs and immune-checkpoint blockade / T-cell activation in murine cancer models; single-cell RNA-seq after KRAS G12D inhibition in PDAC models; engineered EVs for combined mRNA and protein vaccine delivery; MSC-derived EVs for GLP-compliant in vivo studies.
Skills: cGMP compliance, ISO-classified cleanroom operations, controlled documentation, batch record execution and review, deviation/CAPA support, assay development and validation, flow cytometry, NTA, cell sorting, qPCR, Western blot, scRNA-seq, FlowJo, Prism, Office.
Publications: 6 peer-reviewed (Cancer Cell 2023, Nature Communications 2026, EMBO Journal 2026, ACS Nano 2025, Journal of Controlled Release 2024, Bioactive Materials 2024) and 1 bioRxiv preprint (2026).
Direction: moving toward business roles (business development, strategy, operations/PMO, technical commercial roles) that use the MBA alongside GMP manufacturing experience.
Willing to travel.
